scope.en: Distinguish a work, an edition, a subject label and a physical holding.
scope.es: Distingue una obra, una edición, una etiqueta temática y un ejemplar localizado.

en: The captured Open Library work /works/OL55649W is linked to distinct editions. The edition /books/OL26429580M reports 1854 and two subject labels. The edition /books/OL34549556M reports 2018 and an LC classification value. Neither observation establishes where a physical copy is held.

A missing classification field means that this captured record omits the field. It does not mean the book has no classification anywhere. The record’s subject strings also provide no inspected authority identifiers.
es: La obra /works/OL55649W de Open Library está vinculada a ediciones distintas. La edición /books/OL26429580M indica 1854 y dos etiquetas temáticas. La edición /books/OL34549556M indica 2018 y un valor de clasificación LC. Ninguna observación establece dónde se encuentra un ejemplar físico.

La ausencia del campo de clasificación significa que el registro capturado no lo incluye. No significa que el libro carezca de clasificación en todos los catálogos. Tampoco se inspeccionaron identificadores de autoridad para sus etiquetas temáticas.

question.en: Which record reports the LC value?

guide.en: Only /books/OL34549556M reports PS3048.A1 2018 in this capture. Do not copy it into other records.
guide.es: Solo /books/OL34549556M indica PS3048.A1 2018 en esta captura. No lo copies a otros registros.

choices.es: Este registro capturado no incluye el campo

question.en: What follows from an absent field?
question.es: ¿Qué se deduce de un campo ausente?

guide.en: Absence is record-specific. A present empty array would be a different observation.
guide.es: La ausencia corresponde a este registro. Un arreglo presente pero vacío sería una observación diferente.

choices.en: Yes, it is a shelf address
choices.es: Sí, es una ubicación en la estantería

choices.en: No; institution and holdings evidence are missing
choices.es: No; faltan la institución y los datos de existencias

question.en: Does a classification value locate an available copy?
question.es: ¿Un valor de clasificación localiza un ejemplar disponible?

guide.en: A classification is not verified holdings or availability. Keep the unknown fields unknown.
guide.es: Una clasificación no verifica existencias ni disponibilidad. Conserva como desconocidos los campos que no se han comprobado.

transfer.es: Elige dos registros de otra obra. Escribe por separado qué indica cada uno, qué comparten y qué todavía no puedes inferir.

evidence.text:
# Local programme author check — 23 October 2026

Four original studies contain English and Spanish editorial editions and twelve shared reasoning tasks. The author read the stated WWC recommendations/evidence labels, National Gallery account, and OpenStax accounting sections. The selected Crossref record was captured and its publication/deposit/index fields read separately. Earlier Open Library capture hashes matched their retained packet; those are retained observations, not fresh API readings. No source media, abstract or extended quotation is reproduced. The new LOC SRU page timed out and was not retried.

The first ten offline groups passed: exact accepted depth targets, prerequisite traversal with missing nodes and cycles, language/task completeness, independent study identities and stale-check detection, ledger conservation plus omission/unequal-entry counterexamples, separate provider identities and missing fields, separate Crossref dates and excluded abstracts, bounded retrieval failures without retries, honest practice-note exports, and static/escaped rendering. The original fictional ledger yields cash 810, equipment 240, liabilities 150, equity 900 and assets 1050; omitting the entire borrowing entry still balances and is explicitly wrong.

Spanish is an AI-author editorial edition, not a professionally or community-validated translation. Source metadata remains in its observed language. The National Gallery age discrepancy is excluded from conclusions. The source-reading scope and reuse boundaries are recorded in program/research.json and program/federated-catalog.json.

These are local author checks, not independent review, certification or observed learning. Native-browser and assembled-delivery evidence will be recorded in a separate delivery receipt after execution. This source receipt is retained unchanged with each new edition.
